limitations: Publication (doi:10.1002/pmic.201700238) is closed access: Unpaywall closed, not in PMC, Wiley pages 403. Methods, figures and supplementary tables were not read; only the abstract and PRIDE protocol text.

Neither the PRIDE description nor the paper abstract mentions the nid-1 strain; the genotype dimension comes solely from the deposited MaxQuant experiment names ('NID1(L) N2(H)'), cross-validated by NID-1 protein intensity in proteinGroups.txt. Whether the paper analysed only the N2 channel is unknown.
nid-1 allele and strain designation are not stated in any readable source: characteristics[strain or breed] = not available on nid-1 rows; genotype written as 'nid-1 mutant' without allele.
How worms were SILAC-labelled (e.g. heavy-lysine-fed E. coli) is not described in readable sources; not needed for any column.
